info.description: Stripe's official OpenAPI file, trimmed by BYOMCP to common reads (customers, payments, invoices, subscriptions, catalog, balance, refunds, payouts, disputes).
info.title: Stripe API

get.description:
Returns a list of transactions that have contributed to the Stripe account balance (for example, charges, transfers, and so on). The transactions return in sorted order, with the most recent transactions appearing first.

The previous name of this endpoint was “Balance history,” and it used the path /v1/balance/history.

parameters.description: Only return transactions that were created during the given date interval.
parameters.name: created

parameters.description: Only return transactions in a certain currency. Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. get.description: Search for customers you’ve previously created using Stripe’s Search Query Language. Don’t use search in read-after-write flows where strict consistency is necessary. Under normal operating conditions, data is searchable in less than a minute. Occasionally, propagation of new or updated data can be up to an hour behind during outages. Search functionality is not available to merchants in India.
